cands.bio: Republican member of the Alabama House of Representatives for District 22 since November 2014. Co-owns and manages All Star Pools, Inc. Attended New Hope High School and Jacksonville State University.
cands.gaps: We couldn't find where Ritchie Whorton was born or raised, or when he came to Alabama. We found no statements from him on data centers, homestead taxes, land ownership, growth, immigration, campaign money, policing, guns, abortion or school choice, because he did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate surveys in 2022 or 2026. The pages we read show no specific bills he sponsored or actions he took on these issues. We also found no endorsements, controversies or foreign ties in the pages available.

qual.background: Alabama House member for District 22 since 2014 (12 years), vice chair of the House Local Legislation Committee and the Urban and Rural Development Committee, and co-owner and manager of All Star Pools, Inc.
